name: Miracom
summary: Business broadband + voice provider (Miracom Telecommunications, ~2005, ACN 112 299 457); defunct.

events.details: Defunct. Applying the last-retail-homepage convention: the frozen Miracom ISP homepage survived to Mar 2019; the c.2009 business stall is real but the homepage outlived it. site frozen from c.2009.

refs.label: The same Miracom retail ISP homepage was still being served at the last capture, 6 Mar 2019
Site unchanged from c.2009 onwards, so the business plainly wound down around 2009 but the homepage never disappeared before 2019
